data.value: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?

Torchlight Media is undergoing a restructuring. The managing director has the authority to inform staff about the decision. The works council has a consultation deadline at the end of September 2026. The managing director can communicate with staff through official channels (e.g., email, meeting).
